audience: developers and teams who turn audio and video into text with Rev.ai

useCases.title: Submit a recording for transcription
useCases.text: The AI starts a machine transcription job for an audio or video file at a public URL. It uses your Rev.ai credit.

useCases.title: Check recent jobs and their status
useCases.text: The AI lists jobs of the last 30 days with status, name, duration, language and failure reason, and opens one job by id.

useCases.title: Read a transcript with speakers and times
useCases.text: The AI reads a finished job's transcript as plain text with speaker labels, or as segments with speaker, start and end. It can summarize it.

useCases.title: Get captions or a summary of a finished job
useCases.text: The AI fetches captions as SRT or WebVTT, and the summary when the job was submitted with a summarization type.

useCases.title: Check credit balance and delete old jobs
useCases.text: The AI reads your balance and the account details. It can delete a finished job with its media and transcript for good.
